title: When the Compass Falls
author: Bram Quintana
blurb: Edmund Nakamura, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must cross the range ahead of the snows before the concession permits expire.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
